snippet.title: Indie Hoverboard Racing | Open World Demo Gameplay | Free on Steam Now
snippet.description:
Ride. Race. Explore. The Indie Hoverboard Racing demo is LIVE on Steam — and it's completely free to play!

Tear through an open world on your hoverboard, take on quests, discover hidden spots, or go head-to-head in race modes. This is just a taste of what's coming — and we want YOU to try it.

🛹 Play the FREE demo on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4315080/Indie_Hoverboard_Racing/

What's in the demo:
- Open world exploration
- Quest progression
- Race modes

Drop your thoughts in the comments — we read everything. If you enjoyed it, a like and subscribe helps more than you know. 🙏

🎵 Music: W.T.F. (Tinlicker Remix) – Moon Boots
Released on Anjunadeep
Stream/Buy: https://anjunadeep.ffm.to/wtfrx.pbt
